newsitem.title: USA: BP/Chevron confirm Alaska oil find.
newsitem.headline: BP/Chevron confirm Alaska oil find.

text.p: BP Exploration Inc and Chevron USA on Thursday confirmed discovery of a possible 100- million-barrel oil reserve at their Sourdough prospect in Alaska's North Slope oil region.
"BP and Chevron believe the field could be economically developable," Eric Luttrell, vice president of exploration and new developments for BP Exploration, said in a statement.
The companies discovered oil with the Sourdough No. 2 exploratory well in 1994, and confirmed the find with a No. 3 well completed in April 1996.
"We are in the process of planning further technical work in the area to determine the extend and economic viability of the discovery," Luttrell said.
A delineation well is planned for winter 1998.
BP owns two-thirds and operates Sourdough, while Chevron holds the rest.
